clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity’s southwest quarter, the Apothecarium drives the Royal Apothecary Society’s work. Under Master Apothecary Faranell, Forsaken alchemists pursue plagues, toxins, and engineered horrors for Lady Sylvanas’s campaign against the living and the Scourge.

The Apothecarium fills the Undercity’s southwestern terrace with vats, dissection tables, and chemical fumes. Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society’s work there, studying mortality and rot. Alchemists and surgeons experiment with tissue grafts and vivisection, and assemble mighty abominations. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has charged them with creating a plague that can eradicate both the Scourge and the lingering human presence across Lordaeron.

The quarter draws alchemists and herbalists from across the Horde in the Eastern Kingdoms. Initiates and masters gather beside toxic canals to distill concoctions, study botanical blights, and seek counsel from master practitioners.
